configuration.sampling: greedy argmax; seed has no stochastic effect at temperature 0

methodology.claims: descriptive Phase 1 baseline only; no optimization or cross-format performance claim
methodology.cold_load: first and only llama_model_load_from_file call in a fresh process; OS page cache was not flushed
methodology.decode_latency: each subsequent token decode plus finite greedy argmax; memory sampling excluded
methodology.decode_throughput: generated tokens after the first divided by their summed decode latency; natural EOG is preserved
methodology.percentiles: NumPy linear interpolation; decode p50/p95/p99 pool all post-first-token latencies from five measured runs
methodology.prompt_throughput: prompt token count divided by TTFT
methodology.rss: Linux getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss process high-water mark, converted from KiB
methodology.run_aggregation: arithmetic mean/min/max and population standard deviation across five measured runs
methodology.ttft: prompt decode plus finite greedy argmax for the first generated token; context creation excluded
methodology.vram: device-wide total-minus-free sampled before load, after load/context, and after each timed decode; sampling occurs outside latency intervals
methodology.warmup: executed and retained for stability comparison but excluded from performance aggregation
